create_logger_instance: create a Logger instance with quiet mode, log file path, rank, and prefix for distributed training logging
add_line_to_logger: add a line of text to the Logger which writes to file or prints to stdout depending on quiet mode
create_progress_meter: create a ProgressMeter with num_batches, meters list, phase name, epoch, logger, and tensorboard writer
display_progress: display the current batch progress with date, phase, batch number, and meter values to logger or stdout
synchronize_meters_across_gpus: synchronize meter averages across all GPUs using torch distributed all_gather for multi-GPU training
